attackers_goals: Attackers may attempt to move laterally over the network by using compromised accounts or machines to connect to remote hosts using the RDP protocol.
description: The endpoint performed a rare RDP session to a remote host.
detector_tags: NDR Lateral Movement Analytics, NDR Unmanaged Subnet Analytics
investigative_actions: Inspect the legitimacy of the user which the RDP made the connection with. Verify that this isn't IT activity.
name: Abnormal RDP session to a remote host from a rarely seen host
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs
